contract: Lipschitz-bounded resource trajectory with preserved practical interruptibility
divergence_point: After the expected transition window has passed and an observation establishes that the external process remains blocked or stalled with no new actionable information.
negative_trace: observe external process after expected transition window
observe again without new expected decision value
positive_trace: observe external process after expected transition window
classify the phase before interpreting unchanged state
if steady or fault and externally blocked, checkpoint current evidence
permit another observation only when timing or new expected value justifies it
bounded_alternative: Interpret unchanged state in phase context; initialization may justify a timed recheck, while a stalled steady/fault state requires bounded diagnosis or checkpoint rather than recursive polling.
provenance: Observed in human-AI repository work on 2026-08-09 after repeated monitoring of an external run degraded steering and interface responsiveness, then corrected by the human to distinguish initialization from a true stall. The numerical distances are seed-model parameters, not empirical measurements.
